open_task_policy: Accept every correct proof under the actual hypotheses, including short proofs using applicable background theorems. Author proof order, counterexamples, vocabulary and length are not mandatory. Explicitly conditional contributions are distinct from completing the original task; honest incompleteness is distinct from invalid proof.
required_evidence: Construct the least fixed point of each actual three-block monotone map and prove monotonicity in the external parameter, without adding completeness to P.
Justify the intermediate parameterized least solutions and reduced maps, and prove every block elimination/regrouping gives the simultaneous least solution, not merely a fixed point.
Prove exact transport of the least solution through the stated Galois connection using the actual one-step intertwining law, and relate it to the eliminated result.
critical_errors: Identify the supremum of the omega iterations with the least fixed point without establishing that this supremum is a fixed point (for example using an applicable continuity property); monotonicity alone does not suffice. Continuity is sufficient, not necessary.
Freeze every other block at bottom independently and treat the resulting components as a joint solution.
Verify only fixed-point equations and omit the leastness that every elimination step and transport comparison requires.
Assume pointwise least solutions are monotone without proving the parameter comparison or invoking a matching theorem.
Claim arbitrary monotone semiconjugacies preserve least fixed points; omit the actual adjunction in the reverse inequality.
Invert alpha, assume an order embedding/Galois insertion, or add preservation of meets although only the stated adjunction is available.
Treat the given one-step intertwining relation as already asserting the least-solution transport being asked for.
completion_policy: All three main obligations must be completed. A correct Bekić theorem plus exact adjoint fixed-point transport is sufficient; no transfinite ordinal construction or explicit six-permutation enumeration is required.
